Background/Legal Context
• Virginia Code mandates that the Superintendent of each school
division prepare a needs-based and balanced budget every year.
• That budget is to be presented first to the local School Board for
approval and then to the local governing body for approval.
• The budget should include an “estimate of the amount of money
deemed to be needed during the next fiscal year for the support
of the public schools of the school division.”

Alignment with Strategic Pillars
• QUALITY WORKFORCE
• Average 5.5% increase in compensation for all eligible staff effective July 1st
• 6.5% increase for support staff
• 5.5% increase for certified and licensed staff
• 5% increase on average for administrative staff
• 5% increase on average in hourly rates
• Contract length adjustments
• Increased employer contributions to health insurance,
• Health insurance discounts for married couples who are both employees of MCPS
• INCLUSIVE AND COLLABORATIVE LEARNING ENVIRONMENT
• Participate program investment (Visiting International Faculty)
• Funding to support Pathways Alternative Education Program
• Custodian for New Jennie Dean Elementary
• Additional CTE testing and instructional materials
• Increased funding for school custodial supply budget

MANASSAS CITY PUBLIC SCHOOLS  19
Alignment with Strategic Pillars
• CULTURE OF CARING
• Funding for annual Handle with Care recertifications
• Funding for Project Lead The Way (PLTW) Training
• Funding to support teacher transition to New Jennie Dean Elementary
• Increased funding to support implementation of school programs
• STRONG FAMILY AND COMMUNITY PARTNERSHIPS
• Increased funding for communication and family engagement

MANASSAS CITY PUBLIC SCHOOLS  20
Responding to Meet and Confer
•Quality Workforce: Compensation
• Targeted compensation increase for support staff
• EPED increases for special education and ESOL lead teachers, plus addition of EPED for special
education teachers who are case managers
• Increased EPEDs for maintenance staff with specialized licenses
• Increased EPEDs for support staff serving as substitute teacher of record
•Culture of Caring: Leave Modernization
• Personal leave – ability to roll over 2 days for a maximum of 5 days in a given year
• Bereavement leave – regulation being updated to allow for additional leave (sick or personal)
beyond the allotted 5 days with approval by Superintendent or designee
• Child School Event leave – 8 hours of paid leave available to employees (in two 4-hour
increments) to attend school event for their child
• Gift of Time - being shared earlier in the year

MANASSAS CITY PUBLIC SCHOOLS  21
Adjustments
• To balance the budget the following adjustments were made:
• Salary Lapse
• Salary lapse includes turnover and vacancy savings which totaled $989,000
• Position turnover represents the savings realized when experienced
employees retire or leave the division and are replaced by employees with
less experience who earn a lower salary
• Vacancy Savings
• Vacancy savings occur when a position is vacant, which primarily occurs
during the employee turnover process
